title: With elevated font size, desktop icons on screens with 100% scale factor vertically overlap when labels span two lines
line: With a larger font, desktop icons with two-line names no longer overlap the icon below them.
explanation: The desktop's icon cell height reserved Kirigami.Units.gridUnit (a fixed 18 px) for each label line, while the highlight frame is sized from the label's real height. At 10 pt a line is 18 px so the two match, but at 12 pt a line is 22 px, so a two-line label made the frame 8 px taller than the cell and it ran into the item below; leftover screen space hid this at some resolutions (e.g. 1280x800), which is why it seemed to depend on resolution and scale. The cell height now uses the larger of the grid unit and the label font's line height (rounded up), so the default 10 pt layout is unchanged and larger fonts get taller cells.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: make icon cells tall enough for the label font

Icon cells reserved one grid unit per label line, but the grid unit does
not follow the font size, so with a bigger font two-line labels made the
highlight overflow into the item below. Use the font's line height too.

BUG: 514581

media.caption: Master, 12 pt font, 1920x1080: the selected two-line item's highlight runs into the hovered item below.
With the fix, same steps: the cells are taller and the two highlights are separated.
